goal: Prevent wallet history RPCs from reporting false recipient send entries and negative fees for mixed-input transactions
Give users accurate accounting for collaborative transactions like CoinJoins and Payjoins
agreement: Initial approach objections against omitting send entries were addressed by a reworked proposal (luke-jr, rkrux, achow101)
Past objection against omitting send entries has not been explicitly re-reviewed (achow101)
Concept support for avoiding false history accounting on collaborative transactions (rkrux, murchandamus, arejula27)
Tested on regtest and supported because the wallet avoids showing unverifiable data (Bicaru20)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a long-standing accounting flaw in history RPCs for collaborative transactions
Users of CoinJoins and Payjoins will no longer see fabricated sends and erroneous or negative fees
